description: Official IPGeolocation.io MCP server with 17 tools for IP geolocation, security indicators, ASN data, abuse contacts, time zones, astronomy and user-agent parsing. Runs locally with Node.js 22 or later. Supports bulk requests and cached-result pagination.

notes: API key through IPGEOLOCATION_API_KEY for 15 API tools. get_my_ip works without a key. get_cached_result reads stored pages within the original key scope and process. API plan restrictions apply.
